declarations.description: Dictionary panel body: a word-or-phrase field and the definitions found for it. Lookup is host-supplied, through a `lookup` function or a POST to `endpoint`, and with neither the panel says no service is configured. The toolbar shell that mounts it owns `visible` and the floating chrome, and a `term` set from a text selection opens the panel already searched.
declarations.name: ToolDictionary

members.name: termRequestId
members.description: Identity of the current `term`, changing once per time it was asked for. Optional: a host assigning `term` directly need not mint one, and the panel falls back to the term itself. What it buys is a learner selecting the same word twice — a second request for `cat` has a new id, so it re-runs, where an unchanged `term` alone looks like a re-render.

members.name: lookup
members.description: Host-supplied resolver, preferred over `endpoint`. A property rather than an attribute because it is a function; a host with its own client passes it directly instead of routing through HTTP shaping this package guessed at.

members.name: headers
members.description: Extra request headers for the `endpoint` path, read per request so a short-lived token is fetched fresh rather than captured at mount. Only for a host whose route is not authorised by the assessment's own session: the endpoint is called `same-origin` by default, so a route behind that session needs nothing here.

members.name: credentials
members.description: Overrides the `same-origin` default for the `endpoint` path.
